lead: Dairy products, eggs and their plant-based alternatives. Everyday milk, cream, butter, eggs and plant drinks are kept to the right kind and what makes a good one, while cheese, the enthusiast area, is organised by make family, then named or protected-origin cheese, then producer or affineur, then age.

depts.note: Tier: brands that cover most of the market plus independent test winners (≈5–12 per kind). Fat level, treatment and lactose-free are types, not kinds.

b.v: named herd or farm; Jersey or Guernsey for richness; hay milk (Heumilch TSG)
b.w: Breed and feed set the fat, protein and flavour; hay milk is an EU traditional speciality.
Gentler heat keeps more fresh flavour; UHT trades taste for shelf life.

s.brief: Tier trim. Cut the cow's-milk list from 30 SKUs to national market leaders plus test winners. Keep regional co-ops only where they dominate a large market (Amul, Mengniu, Yili, Arla, Lactalis). Make the TSG hay-milk entries types or notes, not models. Add two NEW kinds: camel milk (e.g. Camelicious, Desert Farms) and flavoured milk drinks (chocolate, strawberry and banana milk, e.g. Binggrae Banana Flavored Milk, Yoo-hoo, Cravendale/Frijj-type; sweet lassi stays with fermented drinks). Source both.

k.brief: Types: whole, semi-skimmed, skimmed, lactose-free, A2, organic, raw, UHT/long-life, hay milk. Lactose-free stops being its own kind.
NEW. Fresh and powdered camel milk sold to consumers.
NEW. Sweetened, flavoured milk drinks such as chocolate, strawberry, banana and coffee milk. Iconic brands as models.

s.brief: Restraint. Merge the fat-tier kinds into one Cream kind with types. Keep the cultured and cooked creams separate. Make PDO creams (Crème de Bresse, Cornish clotted cream, Afyon kaymağı) models or notes. Trim to market leaders.

k.brief: Types: single/light, whipping, double/heavy, thickened, aerosol whipped cream.
Types: liquid creamer, dairy whitener powder. Trim the 9 South Asian whiteners to about 6 brands.

s.brief: Restraint. Milk powder moves here from the baby department. Collapse Piracanjuba variants into one model. Make cajeta and manjar types of dulce de leche.

k.brief: Types: evaporated, sweetened condensed, condensed in tube.
Types: skimmed, whole, instant.
Types: dulce de leche, arequipe, manjar, cajeta (goat), doce de leite.

depts.note: Tier for supermarket butter. Variety at the enthusiast end: protected-origin and artisan cultured butters.

b.w: Cultured cream and higher fat give the flavour and texture chefs prize.

b.v: PDO butters (Isigny, Charentes-Poitou, Bresse, Ardenne, Soria)
b.w: Fixes milk area and method; a label of origin, not a grade.

b.v: U.S. Grade AA > U.S. Grade A > U.S. Grade B
b.w: Official USDA grade.

s.brief: Butter: cut the 54 models to market-covering brands (Lurpak, Kerrygold, Président, Anchor, Land O'Lakes, Amul, Président/Elle & Vire) plus test winners. Add archetypes for the named butters enthusiasts compare: Beurre d'Isigny PDO, Beurre Charentes-Poitou PDO (Échiré, Paysan Breton…), Beurre de Bresse PDO, Bordier (Jean-Yves Bordier), Échiré, Beurre rose (Luxembourg), Mantequilla de Soria PDO. Versions are producers. Drop the Turkish and South Asian SKU long tail except leaders. Ghee: merge clarified butter into it. Make Amul's five ghees one model. Add a traditions entry for Indian ghee (desi/bilona) and note smen as a type.

k.brief: Types: salted, unsalted, cultured, flavoured/compound, raw-milk.
Types: cow ghee, buffalo ghee, A2/bilona ghee, clarified butter (beurre noisette-free), smen.
Butter blended with oil. Fix the Lurpak maker to Arla Foods and drop the duplicate range.

depts.note: Tier for supermarket brands. Named traditional cultures (Bulgarian, matsoni, dahi, filmjölk, kefir) as archetypes with craft-tradition entries.

b.v: live cultures, milk and culture only > thickened or sweetened
b.w: Plain live yoghurt needs no starch, gelatine or added sugar.

b.v: e.g. Bulgarsko kiselo mlyako PDO, Silifke yoğurdu GI
b.w: Named cultures and origins mark traditional products.

s.brief: Yoghurt: cut the 70 SKUs. Make archetypes of the named traditional yoghurts: Bulgarian yoghurt (PDO), matsoni/matzoon (merge the two spellings), dahi/curd, mishti doi, Turkish buffalo and sheep yoghurts (GI), Pokot ash yoghurt. Keep about 10 market leaders as models (Danone/Activia, Yoplait, Müller, Chobani, Mengniu, Yili, Amul, Meiji Bulgaria). Strained: Fage Total and Greek PDO-style as archetype; süzme and salcë as types or versions. Skyr: add Icelandic MS Skyr as originating archetype, plus siggi's and Icelandic Provisions. Labneh: drop the 'other' wording; ymer and ylette become types.

k.brief: Types: set, stirred, plain, fruit, probiotic.
Rename from 'Labneh and other thick fermented milk'. Types: labneh, labneh balls in oil, ymer, ylette.

s.brief: Archetypes for named traditions: kefir (grain kefir; Lifeway, Biotiful as versions), ayran, doogh, lassi (plain and sweet), chaas, filmjölk, viili, piimä, amasi/maas, kumis/kumys, ryazhenka, varenets. Add one NEW kind for probiotic cultured shots (Yakult as originator, Actimel, Vifit). Add tradition entries (Caucasian kefir, Nordic soured milks, Central Asian kumys). Trim SKU duplicates.

k.brief: Now includes sweet and flavoured lassi as types; the old exclusion of sweetened drinks is dropped.
Types: cultured buttermilk, traditional churned buttermilk, chaas/chhach.
NEW. Small sweetened bottles of milk fermented with a named probiotic strain (Yakult-type).

depts.note: Make family (shelf) → kind → named or PDO cheese (archetype) → producer or affineur (version) → age, milk and size (detail). Affineurs (Mons, Cantin, Androuët, Neal's Yard Dairy, Jasper Hill Cellars, Fromagerie Quatrehomme, Bernard Antony) go in the brand register.

b.v: single farm or herd, raw milk, pasture-fed
b.w: Farmhouse (fermier) raw-milk cheese from one herd is the first mark of a great cheese.

b.v: named farmhouse maker, matured by a known affineur
b.w: Affineurs select and age wheels; their name on a cheese is a quality signal.

b.v: natural or clothbound rind; sound paste; no ammonia; soft cheese gives under a finger
b.w: Check rind, paste and smell when you buy.
Fixes milk origin, method and maturing area; a label of origin, not a grade.

b.v: Comté green band > brown band; Parmigiano Reggiano Scelto > Mezzano; Grana Padano Riserva 20+ months
b.w: Set by the trade bodies for these cheeses.
World Cheese Awards; Super Gold goes to the final 16.

s.brief: Unripened cheeses. Archetypes: Philadelphia (originating cream cheese), ricotta romana and di bufala PDO, brocciu PDO, manouri, mizithra, requeijão, Boursin (originating Gournay-type), bryndza PDO, Squacquerone PDO, Galotyri/Katiki PDO, quark and fromage blanc, queso fresco/panela/Minas frescal, brunost (Gudbrandsdalsost by Tine as reference, Synnøve Finden). Add a NEW kind for fresh goat's cheese (chèvre frais, e.g. Soignon, Montrachet) and source it. Keep supermarket brands only as market leaders.

k.brief: Rename. Archetypes are the named whey cheeses; ricotta salata is a type.
NEW. Young, unripened, rindless goat's cheese in logs or tubs.
Rename from 'Spreadable soft cheese'. Boursin-type, herbed and regional spreadable fresh cheeses.
Move ripened PDOs listed here (Afuega'l Pitu, Cebreiro, Camerano, Tomme fraîche de l'Aubrac) as archetypes only if they are truly fresh; otherwise hand them to the Spanish/regional shelves.

s.brief: Bloomy-rind cheeses. Brie: Brie de Meaux PDO (reference) and Brie de Melun PDO, then Coulommiers, Brie de Nangis and dairy bries (Président, Castello) as versions. Camembert: Camembert de Normandie PDO (Gillot, Jort, Isigny as versions), Neufchâtel PDO as its own archetype. Dissolve 'Other white-mould soft cheese' into a double- and triple-cream kind: Brillat-Savarin PGI, Chaource PDO, Délice de Bourgogne, Explorateur, Saint-André, Cremont. Move its lactic goat cheeses (Sinodun Hill and similar) to Lactic goat cheese. Crottin kind: archetypes for every Loire and southern goat PDO (Crottin de Chavignol, Sainte-Maure, Valençay, Selles-sur-Cher, Pouligny, Chabichou, Picodon, Pélardon, Rocamadour, Banon), Saint-Marcellin, Robiola di Roccaverano, Humboldt Fog (Cypress Grove). Drop retailer SKUs and untraceable Asian brie lists.

k.brief: Replaces the 'Other white-mould' catch-all. Wigmore and other leftovers either become archetypes here or move to their own make family.
Rename from 'Crottin-type cheese'. Types: ash-coated, natural rind, leaf-wrapped.

s.brief: Dissolve 'Other washed-rind cheese' into named kinds, each with PDO archetypes and producer or affineur versions. Époisses (Berthaut, Gaugry) with Langres, Soumaintrain, Ami du Chambertin. Munster-Géromé. Reblochon and Chevrotin. Taleggio and Quartirolo. Vacherin Mont-d'Or (AOP and Haut-Doubs PDO). Pont-l'Évêque and Livarot. Maroilles. Limburger with Herve and Romadur. Saint-Nectaire. Monastery cheese (Port-Salut, Saint-Paulin, Chimay, Esrom PGI, Oka). Tilsit. Harzer and sour-milk cheese (Olomoucké tvarůžky, Handkäse, Graukäse, gamalost). Add new-world icons as versions or archetypes (Gubbeen, Winnimere, Rush Creek). Source all new kinds.

k.brief: Holds the old catch-all id. Redistribute its archetypes to the kinds on this shelf, to Alpine or Spanish shelves, or to the Italian shelf (Puzzone di Moena).
Trappist and abbey semi-soft washed-rind cheeses (Port-Salut, Chimay, Esrom, Oka).

s.brief: Cooked or pressed mountain cheeses. The old Comté kind is a catch-all for every alpine PDO. Keep Comté AOP there with fruitières and affineurs (Marcel Petite, Arnaud, Seignemartin) as versions and age as detail. Move Beaufort and Abondance to Beaufort. Move Bergkäse, Alpkäse, L'Etivaz and Glarner to Bergkäse & Alpkäse. Move Montasio, Piave, Bitto and Tolminc to the Italian shelf. Move Greek San Michali and gravieras to Regional pressed cheese. Gruyère AOP: d'Alpage, Réserve, cave-aged (Kaltbach) as versions; Kars gravyeri becomes a Turkish archetype. Add NEW kinds for Appenzeller (Appenzeller Käse GmbH), Tête de Moine AOP (with girolle note), Morbier PDO and Vacherin fribourgeois AOP. Add a Swiss and Jura alpine cheesemaking tradition entry.

k.brief: Tomme de Savoie, Tome des Bauges, Toma Piemontese, Tomme des Pyrénées as archetypes.

s.brief: Cheddar: West Country Farmhouse Cheddar PDO as the reference archetype, with Montgomery's, Keen's and Westcombe (the Artisan Somerset Cheddar makers) as versions and Neal's Yard Dairy as affineur. Add Cabot Clothbound, Quicke's, Isle of Mull, Orkney PGI, Cathedral City and Kerrygold as market versions, plus Dunlop. Age bands (mild to vintage) and clothbound vs block are details. Territorials: Appleby's or Mrs Kirkham's style farmhouse archetypes for Cheshire, Lancashire, Wensleydale, Caerphilly (Gorwydd) and Single/Double Gloucester (Charles Martell). Add NEW kinds Red Leicester (Sparkenhoe) and Derby/Sage Derby. Pull British entries out of the old tomme catch-all (Staffordshire, Swaledale, Teviotdale, Cornish Kern). American Colby and Monterey Jack, with Dry Jack (Vella) as an archetype.

Parmigiano Reggiano PDO as the originator, with age as the detail axis (12/24/30/36+ months, Vacca Rossa, Bruna, mountain). Grana Padano PDO with its age classes; Trentingrana, Sbrinz, Reggianito, Džiugas and American grana (BelGioioso) as related archetypes. Pecorino: Romano, Toscano, Sardo, Siciliano, Fiore Sardo and di Fossa PDOs. Move Spanish sheep cheeses (Idiazábal, Roncal, Zamorano, Ossau-Iraty) and Greek and Croatian ones out to their shelves. Asiago (pressato and d'allevo). Add NEW kinds Montasio & Piave, and Italian mountain cheese (Castelmagno, Bra, Raschera, Bitto, Valtellina Casera, Puzzone).

k.brief: Rename from 'Parmesan'.

s.brief: Dissolve 'Other blue cheese' into named kinds. Roquefort: Société, Papillon, Carles and Gabriel Coulet as versions. Stilton: Colston Bassett, Cropwell Bishop, Long Clawson and Tuxford & Tebbutt; Stichelton as a raw-milk archetype. Gorgonzola: dolce and piccante. French blues: Bleu d'Auvergne, Fourme d'Ambert, Bleu des Causses, Bleu de Gex, Bleu du Vercors-Sassenage. Spanish blues: Cabrales, Valdeón, Picón Bejes-Tresviso, Gamonéu. Danish blue (Danablu PGI). Blue brie and soft blue (Cambozola by Käserei Champignon, Saint Agur, Blue Castello). British, Irish and American farmhouse blue: Cashel Blue, Shropshire Blue, Beenleigh Blue, Bayley Hazen, Point Reyes, Rogue River Blue. Trim the 82-item list to sourced archetypes.

k.brief: Holds the old catch-all id. British, Irish and North American farmhouse blues; other entries go to the kinds above.

s.brief: Pasta filata. Mozzarella di Bufala Campana PDO as the reference archetype, then fior di latte, Mozzarella TSG and low-moisture (cooking) mozzarella. Burrata di Andria PGI and stracciatella. Provolone Valpadana and del Monaco. Caciocavallo Silano and Ragusano (as archetypes within Provolone & caciocavallo). Add a NEW kind for scamorza and provola (smoked). Kashkaval: kaşar and kasseri PDO. Braided string cheese: Oaxaca, çeçil, chechil, korbáčik, parenica. Sulguni moves here from brined cheese. Cut shredded and diced supermarket SKUs.

Gouda: Noord-Hollandse Gouda PDO and Boerenkaas (farmhouse) as archetypes, Gouda Holland PGI as the market pattern. Versions: Beemster, Reypenaer, Old Amsterdam, Prima Donna, Cypress Grove Midnight Moon (goat). Age bands (jong to overjarig) as detail. Edam and Leidse kaas/nagelkaas. Havarti PGI. Add NEW kinds: Maasdam & Jarlsberg (Maasdammer, Leerdammer, Jarlsberg), Danbo PGI, and Swedish hard cheese (Västerbottensost, Präst, Herrgård, Grevé; Svecia PGI). Cut the ex-Asian and African gouda SKUs to market leaders.

Manchego PDO with artesano vs industrial and curing age (fresco, semicurado, curado, viejo) as detail; producers become versions. Torta del Casar, La Serena, Serra da Estrela and Azeitão PDOs. Add NEW kinds with archetypes: Idiazábal & Roncal; Mahón-Menorca; Tetilla & Galician cheese (Tetilla, Arzúa-Ulloa, San Simón da Costa); Spanish goat cheese (Majorero, Palmero, Ibores, Murcia al vino, Payoyo); Portuguese cured cheese (São Jorge, Nisa, Évora, Rabaçal, Terrincho); Queijo Minas artesanal (Canastra, Serro and other IPs). Cotija. Take these entries from the old tomme catch-all. Drop untraceable producer SKUs.

The old 'Other tomme-type cheese' (about 190 entries) is dissolved. Its id sits on Cantal & Salers (Cantal, Salers, Laguiole PDOs). Every other entry moves to its family shelf or, if it is a one-producer SKU with no reference record, is dropped. Add NEW kinds: Pyrenean sheep cheese (Ossau-Iraty, Abbaye de Belloc, Etorki) and Greek hard cheese (Graviera Kritis/Naxou/Agrafon, Kefalograviera, Kefalotyri, San Michali, Ladotyri). Also here: Tulum and skin-ripened cheese (Erzincan, Bergama, guda, motal) and Roomi.

Feta PDO as the originator, with producers (Dodoni, Kolios, Mevgal, Epiros) as versions and barrel-aged vs tin as detail; non-PDO 'white cheese' moves to Brined white cheese. Brined white cheese archetypes: beyaz peynir (Ezine GI), sirene PDO, telemea PDO/PGI, Domiati, Lighvan, Imeruli, Sjenički, Batzos and Kalathaki PDOs. Halloumi PDO (Cyprus) as the originator, with versions. Grilling cheese: queijo coalho, juustoleipä, kalari, formaella. Trim the Turkish SKU list.

Pastoral dried dairy. Merge qurut and jameed (dried salted yoghurt balls; kurt, aaruul-type regional names as types). Each kind gets one archetype or tradition source. Add a tradition entry for Central Asian and Mongolian 'white foods' and for Himalayan chhurpi.

Tier restraint. Processed cheese: cut to market leaders (Kraft Singles, The Laughing Cow, Dairylea, Snow Brand 6P, Président, Pınar, Almarai). Move Queijo Marajó and Wielkopolski ser smażony to notes or drop. Cheese selections: keep the kind as gift boxes and boards. Remove its models, which are single cheeses rather than selections.

k.brief: Types: slices, triangles, blocks, spread, cubes.

b.v: organic > free range > barn > enriched cage (EU codes 0 to 3)
b.w: The EU code is printed on the shell.
Pasture-raised is not regulated.

b.v: USDA Grade AA > USDA Grade A > USDA Grade B
b.w: The lowest of shell, white and yolk sets the grade; shell colour only shows the breed.

s.brief: Restraint. Merge liquid and dried egg into one egg-products kind with types. Breed eggs (Burford Brown, Cotswold Legbar) are types of hen's egg, not kinds.

k.brief: Types: size, housing, breed or shell colour, enriched (omega-3).
Types: century egg, salted duck egg, pickled egg, boiled egg.
Types: liquid whole, liquid white, yolk, egg powder.

depts.note: All kinds carry the 'baby' tag. Milk powder moves to Milk & cream.

b.w: All first infant formula meets one legal standard; choose by stage and protein base only.
The base matters for allergies and tolerance.

s.brief: Trim to market-covering brands (Aptamil/Nutricia, Similac, Enfamil, HiPP, Kendamil, Feihe, Meiji, Nestlé NAN). Put ranges once (e.g. HiPP Combiotik) rather than repeating them on three kinds; drop the duplicated Zhenweiai range. Types: powder, ready-to-feed, goat, hydrolysed.

b.v: barista vs standard; fortified with calcium and B12
b.w: Plant milks are chosen by base and use (coffee, frothing, cooking); there are no grades.
Ethical Consumer scores out of 100 on ownership, ingredient impact and packaging.

s.brief: Add market leaders and test winners (Oatly, Alpro, Silk, Califia, Minor Figures, Vitasoy, Rude Health). Merge walnut and peanut into one nut-and-seed kind (cashew, hazelnut, walnut, peanut, hemp as types). Add NEW kinds for rice drink and pea drink (Ripple, Sproud) and source them. Fix the Soyog range repeated on three kinds.

k.brief: Types: standard, barista, light.

s.brief: Restraint. Merge the two plant-cheese kinds into one with types. Add leaders as models where known from existing sources (Violife, Alpro, Oatly).

k.brief: Types: block, slices, grated, soft/spreadable, cultured nut cheese.

depts.note: Moved in from J5 Pantry Staples. Tier for meat analogues; tofu, yuba and tempeh have Asian craft traditions.

b.v: nigari/magnesium chloride vs gypsum; silken to extra-firm
b.w: The coagulant sets flavour and texture in tofu.
Buyers compare protein, salt and ingredient list.

s.brief: All kinds are NEW and must be sourced (they leave J5; the J5 worker removes them there). Tofu: types silken, firm, extra-firm, smoked, fried (aburaage), fermented (furu, stinky tofu). Add a Japanese and Chinese tofu-making tradition entry and model brands such as Morinaga Mori-Nu, House Foods, Taifun, Cauldron. Tempeh: Indonesian tradition entry (UNESCO-nominated tempe culture, to verify). Seitan, yuba, plant-based meat (Beyond Meat, Impossible Foods as originating archetypes; burgers, mince, sausages, nuggets, plant fish as types) and mycoprotein (Quorn as originator). Textured vegetable protein stays in J5 as a dry good unless J5 sends it.
